project_type: Vanilla JavaScript SPA with Supabase backend, teacher dashboard admin panel
build_system: None (direct HTML + JavaScript modules, no bundler)
test_command: Manual browser testing at http://localhost:PORT or file:// protocol
verification_instructions: Open each affected HTML page in browser, log in as teacher, and verify: (1) delete buttons trigger confirmation modals and delete records with success toast; (2) view/edit buttons open modals or navigate; (3) upload buttons trigger file input; (4) logout buttons (sidebar, header, profile) all trigger logout confirmation; (5) save operations show success/error toasts; (6) notifications appear at top of page
environment_constraints: Must test with a live Supabase connection. The auth.js logout function must clear Supabase session + localStorage. Toast notifications managed by Toast singleton in src/utils/toast.js.
contribution_requirements: Maintain Arabic comments and UI messages. Follow existing code style (ES6 imports, async/await, showConfirmModal for destructive operations). All event listeners must be bound after DOM elements are rendered or exist.
key_patterns: Event delegation pattern: buttons are rendered dynamically in tables/lists, so event listeners are attached after rendering via querySelectorAll. Delete operations use showConfirmModal from teacher-nav.js. Success/error operations call Toast.success/Toast.error. Logout uses authService.logout() then redirects to login.html.
directory_structure: src/scripts/ contains all teacher-*.js modules; src/services/ contains auth.js and supabase.js; src/utils/ contains toast.js; root contains teacher-*.html pages
